what: A test Subject for the late-correction case: two Figure Statements issued in order by this publisher's signing key for the same Subject. Revision 1 is the statement as it stood before the source restated the figure; revision 2 adds source_revision and is the statement in force. Both digests are in transparency/statement-digests.json under test_vectors.

claim.source_document: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report)
claim.table: Table 1. Delinquency Rates by Month (non-seasonally adjusted block)
claim.row: Serious delinquency rate, month of August 2026
claim.exclusions: FHA-insured single-family forward mortgages in active insurance at month end; rates are not seasonally adjusted (the report also prints a seasonally adjusted block, which is not restated here)

source.document: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report)
source.table: Table 1. Delinquency Rates by Month (non-seasonally adjusted block)
source.row: Serious delinquency rate, month of August 2026
source.exclusions: FHA-insured single-family forward mortgages in active insurance at month end; rates are not seasonally adjusted (the report also prints a seasonally adjusted block, which is not restated here)

limits: the delinquency risk of any one borrower or loan
a foreclosure completion or loss rate
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
revisions.test: Test fixture, not a published figure. It mirrors official-hud-lpt-2026-08-serious-delinquency-rate so that a statement issued and then replaced can be checked against the live service.
